pages.title: Fatigue
pages.text: The server gamerule doSleepDeprivation is off by default. When enabled, going without sleep can slow movement and digging, darken the view, cause eyelid blinks and eventually produce hallucinations.

pages.title: Rest
pages.text: Sleep lowers fatigue. Some stimulants keep you awake until they wear down. Going to bed while intoxicated can produce the hangover advancement and a temporary fatigue aftereffect.

pages.title: Recovery Signals
pages.text: Hunger, saturation and health still matter during an effect. If effects linger, let the last dose finish absorbing and wear off. The $(l:psychedelicraft:advanced/stomach)stomach page$(/l) explains what happens after vomiting.
